'''Attila Wurth''' won the [[1997 Sullust Regionals (Prague)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I'm 26, and am a university Veterinary Science student nearing graduation."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/wurth.html Attila Wurth], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428133940/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/wurth.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"I also work, translating novels from English into Hungarian."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My hobbies include collectible (well, customizable) card games, strategic computer games, role-playing games, etc.."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I like sci-fi, fantasy and horror movies and books."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite sport is horseback riding."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Favorite movies of the past year are Lost Highway, The Long Kiss Goodnight and Bean."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I prefer to play Star Wars CCG Light Side."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite Star Wars character is Obi-Wan Kenobi, and my favorite line from the movie was his: 'You can't win, Darth."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"If you strike me down, I shall become more powerful than you can imagine."<ref name="dec97bio" />
